items.title: Mcbee interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: the great Frank Foster who was a previous graduate of my school... his big band had won the national big band contest

ctx.x: That was a rather exciting moment because actually I failed to mention to you that upon arrival in New York City I felt that I was more a composer than a performer. Because in college I mean upon arriving at school I had never played the piano before. I didn’t even know what that was as far as putting my fingers on the keyboard and making something happen. But as a potential music instructor the piano was the first assignment of study. So I fell in love with that and began, you know, exploring, and especially…
